Jimi Hendrix was born on November 27, 1942, and died on September 18, 1970. This means he was 27 years old at the time of his death (he had not yet reached his 28th birthday).

All other agents agree on this answer with very high confidence, and this is consistent with well-documented historical facts. Hendrix is famously part of the "27 Club" - a group of influential musicians who died at age 27.

Answer: 27
Confidence: 1.00
